content.introduction: The latest Deloitte Insights' Weekly Global Economic Update for the week of October 19, 2026, highlights that investors are concerned about artificial intelligence, the 2026 Nobel laureates in economics emphasize the importance of communicating policy, US inflation has accelerated, and Chinese trade is partly driven by AI. The report is authored by Dr. Ira Kalish, Managing Director and Chief US Economist for Deloitte Services LP. The sources do not provide information for the exact date requested, November 8, 2026.

## Week of January 12, 2026

 US productivity surges because of the tech industry
 The US job market shows signs of cooling even as the economy has grown rapidly
 Southeast Asia’s economy has performed well despite headwinds
 The US dollar has weakened considerably in the past year
 Inflation in the Eurozone remains subdued

### US productivity surges because of the tech industry [...] By country, the year-over-year increase in consumer prices in December was 2% in Germany, 0.7% in France, 1.2% in Italy, 3% in Spain, 2.5% in the Netherlands, 2.2% in Belgium, 2.9% in Greece, 2.7% in Ireland, and 1.8% in Finland.
